verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing copy gestures at all-day, unplugged use and low-power AI engines/power management, implying efficiency for thin-and-light designs, but there are no concrete battery-life hour claims, no mention of fanless designs, and no independent hands-on corroboration in the pack. Missing for 10: fanless/thin-chassis design examples, specific battery-life hour figures, independent reviewer benchmarks confirming all-day battery claims.
